body.message:
Hi Chahana,

Thank you very much for sending this option.

The apartment looks nice, but since there will be two of us living there for 9–12 months, we are hoping for a little more space if possible.

Do you have any other options with a larger studio or a 1-bedroom apartment with a kitchen, even if the rent is slightly higher (up to AED 5,000 per month), preferably closer to the University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE Dubai)?

If this is currently the only available option, please let me know as we are seriously considering it.

Thank you very much for your help.
